#include <cstdio>

typedef long long ll;

const ll MOD = 998244353;

ll pow_mod(ll x, ll y, ll p) {
    ll res = 1;
    x %= p;
    while (y > 0) {
        if (y & 1) res = (res * x) % p;
        y >>= 1;
        x = (x * x) % p;
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    ll n, m, l, r;
    scanf("%lld %lld %lld %lld", &n, &m, &l, &r);
    
    ll k = n * m;
    ll len = r - l + 1;
    
    if (k % 2 == 1) {
        printf("%lld\n", pow_mod(len, k, MOD));
    } else {
        ll ans = (pow_mod(len, k, MOD) + pow_mod(len % 2, k, MOD)) % MOD;
        ans = ans * pow_mod(2, MOD - 2, MOD) % MOD;
        printf("%lld\n", ans);
    }
    
    return 0;
}
